name: claude-auth
title: Claude Auth
description: Back up and restore this host's Claude credential (~/.claude/.credentials.json) as a base64 file. Export writes to a 0600 file, import validates the decoded JSON and keeps a timestamped backup.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Claude 凭据备份
zh-CN.description: 把本机 Claude 凭据(~/.claude/.credentials.json)导出为 base64 文件并可还原。导出写入 0600 文件,导入前校验解码结果是 JSON 对象,并保留带时间戳的备份。

tools.name: export
tools.description: Write the credential to a base64 file (mode 0600)

tools.name: import
tools.description: Restore the credential from a base64 file, backing up the existing one

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show credential path, size, mode and mtime — never the contents
